stats.scope: Complete source-reconciled MOD directory across all eight Minecraft versions. Standard lang total counts base plus the minimal 1.21.1 overlay; external-version pack occurrences are reported separately.

countingPolicy.definition: Count every (namespace,key) in 1.20.1 base. For merged 1.21.1, count only keys absent from base or whose value differs from base. Identical fallback/mirror values are excluded. Excludes other-version packs, shaders and hardcoded rules.

changeBreakdown.note: 1.9.1 = 1.9.0 + TOP1M R1 lang files + user-requested mods. The lang audit changed values only; where a corrected 1.21.1 value became identical to 1.20.1 it is no longer counted as an overlay key. R33 introduces 16 source-backed 1.21.1-only value overrides; no translation keys are added.
